query:
SELECT p.id, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.endDate, p.isActive,
       (p.usedHours >= p.totalHours) as is_exhausted,
       (NOW() > p.endDate) as is_date_expired
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'Nicolas' AND r.lastName = 'Klein'
ORDER BY p.id DESC
LIMIT 1;
